answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 10468 Country: Pakistan Title: Assalam-o-alikum, dear sir, how ru. I wanna ask about cyber sex. I use to do it alot. In a recent month i tried to aviod it, but i cant find my self encourage enough to do so..and now i m too egar to start playing again... is it tat bad sin tat i hv to keep my self away from it or i can do it...as it just for fun... to harm feelings Question: Assalam-o-alikum, dear sir, how ru. I wanna ask about cyber sex. I use to do it alot. In a recent month i tried to aviod it, but i cant find my self encourage enough to do so..and now i m too egar to start playing again... is it tat bad sin tat i hv to keep my self away from it or i can do it...as it just for fun... to harm feelings Answer ID: 10468 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 336/336=M/1430) Yes, it is a big sin; you should avoid it in future. It is also not allowed for entertainment and fun. Repent to Allah and ask for His forgiveness, and marry if you are not yet married. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
